create_SamConfig: create a SamConfig instance to configure the SAM model with vision, prompt encoder, and mask decoder sub-configs
create_SamVisionConfig: create a SamVisionConfig instance to configure the vision encoder with hidden size, patch size, and attention settings
create_SamPromptEncoderConfig: create a SamPromptEncoderConfig instance to configure prompt embeddings, image size, and mask input channels
create_SamMaskDecoderConfig: create a SamMaskDecoderConfig instance to configure mask decoding with MLP dimension, attention heads, and IoU head settings
build_SamConfig_from_subconfigs: build a SamConfig from separate SamVisionConfig, SamPromptEncoderConfig, and SamMaskDecoderConfig instances
